# Six Miss Malfoid mood sticker loops

[← Back to all cases](../../README.md#all-cases)

<a href="README.md"><img src="../../assets/badges/language-en-current.svg" alt="Current language: English" height="34" /></a> <a href="README.zh-CN.md"><img src="../../assets/badges/language-zh-CN.svg" alt="View translation: 简体中文" height="34" /></a>

**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

One six-sticker collection, not six cases: shy face-covering, jealousy, folded arms, crying, smug laughter and a hand-heart. The six original MP4 files are 480 × 480, contain 17/13/12/17/12/13 decoded frames and last about 2.1–2.5 seconds each, without audio. Every frame was visually inspected; no real-time playback claim is made. The main montage video has no playable URL in the inspected page and is excluded. The separate Reddit summer-animation entry has no retained media and is access-blocked, so visual deduplication against it remains unresolved; that page was not revisited.
